blinding_guess.why: At Humble, rmw_dds_common 1.6.0 defines Gid as `char[24] data`; the only direct field access in this snapshot (listener_thread.cpp:171-174) memcmp's RMW_GID_STORAGE_SIZE bytes of msg.gid.data against the context gid, and all ParticipantEntitiesInfo handling goes through rmw_dds_common's GraphCache and generated typesupport, so nothing in the snapshot visibly disagrees with the Humble definitions. RMW_GID_STORAGE_SIZE is defined in rmw headers outside the allowed sources, so its value was not checked.

notes: Repo snapshot holds three packages (rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp, rmw_fastrtps_cpp, rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp), all version 6.2.7. Packet gives side=consumes for every element and it is kept as given, but the code both publishes and subscribes on ros_discovery_info: publisher with KEEP_LAST depth 1 (init_rmw_context_impl.cpp:84-85,91-98) and subscription with KEEP_ALL (:116-125), both reliable + transient_local; local messages are filtered by GID compare (listener_thread.cpp:171-178). avoid_ros_namespace_conventions=true (:83) so the DDS topic name has no rt/ prefix (names.hpp:65-66). Deadline is never set: qos starts from rmw_qos_profile_default (:81) and qos.cpp:112-115 only sets a DDS deadline when the rmw deadline is specified, so deadline_ms is null (no deadline). An XML profile keyed by topic name is loaded first (publisher.cpp:250, subscription.cpp:269) but the rmw QoS is applied unconditionally afterwards (publisher.cpp:267, subscription.cpp:278), so reliability/durability are fixed by code. QoS is recorded only on the topic port; msg/field ports are types, not endpoints (they travel only on ros_discovery_info), so their qos is null. msg:rmw_dds_common/Gid, msg:rmw_dds_common/NodeEntitiesInfo, field:rmw_dds_common/NodeEntitiesInfo.reader_gid_seq, field:rmw_dds_common/NodeEntitiesInfo.writer_gid_seq and field:rmw_dds_common/ParticipantEntitiesInfo.node_entities_info_seq are consumed transitively (serialized/deserialized as parts of ParticipantEntitiesInfo; filled by rmw_dds_common GraphCache calls such as add_node at rmw_node.cpp:114) but are not named in this package's code, so they are in neither references nor declares. No element is provided by this package, so declares and not_declared are empty. Definitions fetched from ros2/rmw_dds_common tag 1.6.0 (and branch humble, byte-identical); to pick the Humble release tag I also fetched rmw_dds_common/package.xml at 1.6.0 and at humble (both <version>1.6.0</version>), which goes beyond the definition-files-only allowance; it influenced only the tag choice.
